description_en: Clears all expired keys in a Tair (Redis OSS-compatible) instance
description_zh: 清除云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例中的过期Key
kebab_example: aliyun r-kvstore flush-expire-keys --instance-id r-bp1zxszhcgatnx0000 --effective-time Immediately --region cn-hangzhou
name: FlushExpireKeys

parameters.help_en:
The time when you want to delete the expired keys. Default value: Immediately. Valid values:

*   **Immediately**: deletes the keys immediately.
*   **MaintainTime**: deletes the keys during the maintenance window.

>  You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473775.html operation to modify the maintenance window of an instance
parameters.help_zh:
执行时间，取值：
* **Immediately**：立即执行，默认值。
* **MaintainTime**：在可维护时间段执行。

> 您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473775.html接口修改实例的可维护时间段
parameters.name: effective_time
